ceu: ✦ The square between Venus and Mars

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: The Moon passes through your area of friends and projects. Good company gives you energy today.
The square between Venus and Mars creates some tension between conversations and routine. You do not have to choose right now: look for the middle ground.
With Mercury retrograde in your home and family sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Do a friend a favour without expecting anything in return.

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: Today work and reputation carry emotional weight. Praise or criticism touches you more than usual.
The square between Venus and Mars creates some tension between money and romance. Be firm, but without hardening your heart.
With Mercury retrograde in your communication sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Say no to a task that is not yours.

t: With the Moon in your house of wisdom, the day asks for meaning: ask yourself where you want to go, not just how.
The square between Venus and Mars creates some tension between your image and family. Breathe before reacting, because haste is the worst adviser today.
With Mercury retrograde in your money sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Accept an invitation that is different from usual.

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: The Moon touches intimacy and strong bonds. Open up to those who deserve it, and only to those who deserve it.
The square between Venus and Mars creates some tension between your inner life and conversations. If something goes wrong, it is just an adjustment and not the end.
With Mercury retrograde in your self-image sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Speak frankly about a matter you keep avoiding.

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: A good day for agreements and serious conversations with those who walk beside you. Be clear and fair.
The square between Venus and Mars creates some tension between friendships and money. Tension is a sign of growth, not of failure.
With Mercury retrograde in your inner life sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Give way on something small to gain on something big.

t: The Moon passes through your area of routine and health. Organising the day is the best way to make the most of it.
The square between Venus and Mars creates some tension between your career and your image. Say what you feel calmly and without blaming.
With Mercury retrograde in your friendship sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Book that test or check-up you keep putting off.

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: Today your heart is lighter and more playful. It is a good day for romance and for small pleasures.
The square between Venus and Mars creates some tension between your horizons and your inner life. Hear both sides before you decide.
With Mercury retrograde in your career sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Allow yourself a sweet or a treat without guilt.

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: With the Moon in your house of roots, old memories may return. Welcome them without getting stuck in them.
The square between Venus and Mars creates some tension between intimacy and friendships. Protect your peace and choose the battles worth fighting.
With Mercury retrograde in your horizons sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Tidy a drawer or a corner of the house that bothers you.

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: The Moon livens up short trips and contact with siblings, neighbours and colleagues. A day on the move.
The square between Venus and Mars creates some tension between relationships and your career. A short pause avoids a long argument.
With Mercury retrograde in your intimacy sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Take a different route on your usual way.

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: Today's emotions run through your wallet and through what you consider yours. Protect what you have built, without closing yourself off.
The square between Venus and Mars creates some tension between routine and your horizons. Today's challenge is teaching you patience.
With Mercury retrograde in your relationships sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Treat yourself to a small comfort that costs almost nothing.

t: The Moon passes through your sign today and leaves your emotions close to the surface: it is a day to listen to yourself first and decide later.
The square between Venus and Mars creates some tension between romance and intimacy. Do not take to heart what has nothing to do with you.
With Mercury retrograde in your daily routine sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Wear a colour you really love and notice how it changes your mood.

t: Today sensitivity is high and tiredness may appear. Sleep well and protect yourself from noise.
The square between Venus and Mars creates some tension between family and relationships. Put off big decisions until the dust settles.
With Mercury retrograde in your romance sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Switch off your phone an hour before bed.
